languageModelTools.name: poly_export_marp
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Export Marp slide deck from given Markdown file to specific path. Export command will be invoked in the current workspace.

inputFilePath.description: An absolute path to the input Markdown file.

outputFilePath.description: An absolute path to the output file. The file extension must be one of the supported formats: `.html`, `.pdf`, `.pptx`, `.png`, `.jpg` (`.jpeg`) and `.txt`. If given the image format, the output file will be a single image of the first slide only.
